pageCache.pageTitle: Ferring C of E Primary School - Home
pageCache.text: If your child is starting school in September 2027 we would like to invite you to visit our school. We happily offer school tours so please email office@ferring.w-sussex.sch.uk or call 01903243945 We also have limited places in other year groups and gladly support in year admissions.
